related.title: 受保護量子位元的系統預算：讀出仍會出錯
related.titleEn: Protected-qubit system budgets: readout still matters
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只將結果稱為指定模型的非交換檢驗，不能由一般量子閘的非交換性推斷非阿貝爾準粒子。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Describe the result as a model-specific noncommutation test, not proof of non-Abelian quasiparticles from ordinary gate noncommutation. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 用聯集上界建立多來源失敗預算，避免把物理保護等同完整系統零錯誤。
related.differenceEn: Build a multisource failure budget with a union bound rather than equating physical protection with a flawless system.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。α=β=π/2，理想無雜訊；讀出基底為X。 P(+X)=(1+sin(π/2)cos(π/2))/2。 代入 (1+sin(pi/2)*cos(pi/2))/2，得到 0.5 probability。初態+Z先Rx(α)再Ry(β)，最後X分量=sinβcosα，故P(+X)=(1+sinβcosα)/2；抽象旋轉不證明物理編織。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。教學單週期中毒上界0.001、讀出錯誤0.002、控制錯誤0.0005，三類已定義。 總上界=0.001+0.002+0.0005。 代入 0.001+0.002+0.0005，得到 0.0035 probability upper bound。P任一失敗≤Σpᵢ，無需獨立；事件重疊會使上界更保守，只有互斥事件才能以直接加總得到精確機率。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. α=β=π/2 in a noiseless model withX-basis readout. P(+X)=(1+sin(π/2)cos(π/2))/2. Substituting (1+sin(pi/2)*cos(pi/2))/2 gives 0.5 probability. Starting+Z, applyRx(α) thenRy(β): finalX=sinβcosα, soP(+X)=(1+sinβcosα)/2; abstract rotations do not prove physical braiding. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Teaching per-cycle bounds: poisoning0.001, readout0.002 and control0.0005 with categories defined. Total bound=0.001+0.002+0.0005. Substituting 0.001+0.002+0.0005 gives 0.0035 probability upper bound. P(any failure)≤Σpi without independence; overlapping events make the bound conservative, while exact summation requires disjoint events. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
